subject: general
question:
Select the word that is similar in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below

Malign
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e. **'Baleful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"malign" **is a verb that means to speak ill or unfavorably about someone or something.
 
• **It involves** making harmful, false, or derogatory statements that can damage the reputation or character of the person or thing being discussed.
 
• **"Baleful" **is an adjective that means threatening harm or menacing. It signifies a sense of danger, evil, or harm.(अमंगलकारी)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Baleful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Insurgent" **refers to a person who rises in active revolt against an established authority or government.(विद्रोही)
 
• **"Radical"** refers to someone who advocates for extreme or fundamental changes in political, social, or economic systems. (जरुरत से ज्यादा परिवर्तनशील)
 
• **"Nihilistic" **is an adjective that relates to the philosophy of nihilism, which rejects or denies the existence of inherent meaning or values in life. (निरर्थक)
